decisions: Keep previousRunId as sequential predecessor provenance; do not rename it to inputRunId merely for naming consistency.
Define ActionPackage as a closed machine boundary built by reusing existing Run occurrence, Action identity, execution role, prepared/resumed state, Owner authority and predecessor facts.
Do not introduce PackageId or ResultId in the current single-writer model; the existing Change-scoped Run occurrence is the execution-correlation identity.

Result admission must fail closed on wrong Run occurrence, wrong Action identity, wrong execution role/outcome authority slot, terminal/stale package state, or a Standard Action candidate that claims formal Verification verdict.
Result admission does not interpret nextBoundary or verdict meaning as Policy legality and does not own the later resume/terminal/STOP orchestration loop.
